exceptions.bounded_reason: No rated easy source questions or easy templates observed. This package validates only the observed moderate/hard substitution methods; it does not infer a lower difficulty from absence. Reopen with new easy source evidence.

excluded_sources.reason: Unrated and missing correct answer and worked solution; preserved, excluded from gradable inventory; new source evidence required

finite_sampling_policy: 1 <= scale <= 1000 for each source profile; genuine mathematical fingerprints deduplicate overlap. Do not synthesize identities or shuffle choices to extend this pool.
